title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Black Razz Breeze 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Black Razz Breeze Nic Salt e-liquid combines the bold, rich flavour of Blackcurrants with the tangy sweetness of fresh Raspberries, finished off with a cool, icy exhale. This refreshing combination of berries and menthol creates a balanced and flavour-packed vape that will satisfy fruit and menthol lovers alike. Formulated with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are perfect for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) vape kits and pod systems, delivering a smooth throat hit and fast nicotine satisfaction. Available in both 10mg and 20mg strengths, Black Razz Breeze offers a rich and refreshing vape that’s perfect for all-day use. Pukka Juice are an award-winning UK vape brand renowned for their vibrant and original e-liquid flavours. The Pukka Juice 5000+ range brings intense, disposable vape-inspired flavours to a more versatile format for use with reusable vape devices. Other popular flavours in the range include Fizzy Pop, Lemon & Lime, and Polar Mint.
